svg.title: Lead measurement set-up
svg.text: Lead measurement of the screw (ISO 3408-3) – rotary encoder on the spindle, ball probe in the groove, laser interferometer on the carriage
A Measuring machine (room 20 ± 0.5 °C, screw soaked ≥ 4 h)
granite bed with air-bearing guide for the probe carriage
Principle: the spindle turns the screw by φ; the probe follows the groove and the carriage moves by the actual travel l_a.
Nominal travel l_0 = Ph · φ / 360°. Travel deviation e(φ) = l_a − l_0 (corrected to 20 °C), measured every 1 – 5 mm.
B Lead chart (example screw, useful travel l_u = 700 mm, grade C5)
10 µm error per K over 850 mm.
EXAMPLE – check the machine maker's data
